adaptive_search_disclosure: Opened after prior broad-PIT price, SEC 8-K, Form 4, and reaction-conditioned ownership families were measured. This is adaptive research, not pristine discovery. Section 6.207 used only gap-confirmed/rejected 13D events; this family tests unconditioned medium-horizon activist drift with a pre-entry same-SIC hedge.
hypothesis: An initial active-ownership Schedule 13D may create medium-horizon target-specific drift that survives after shorting a contemporaneous same-industry, similar-size peer.

samples.stage_policy: Independent USD 100000 books. Complete scheduled hold required inside each stage; no carry or truncation across the 2022/2023 boundary.
samples.oos_2025_2026: PROHIBITED. No 2025-2026 prices, features, membership, or performance may be loaded.

event_contract.session_assignment: First full PIT trading session whose 09:15 America/New_York cutoff is strictly later than acceptance; lower bound is the previous session cutoff.
event_contract.deduplication: One earliest exact accession per issuer CIK and assigned session

universe_contract.target: Quarterly Polygon PIT market-cap top500, highest-market-cap security per issuer CIK; current price >= USD 5 and lagged ADV20 >= USD 10m.
universe_contract.peer: Same quarterly PIT snapshot, same non-empty sic_description, different issuer/ticker, current PIT eligible with exact 09:35 entry; minimize absolute log-market-cap distance to target, then ticker ascending.

execution.entry: Exact 09:35 for both legs on the assigned session; skip the entire pair if either leg is unavailable.
execution.exit: Exact 15:55 for both legs on the scheduled hold session; if either leg is unavailable, delay the entire pair until both exact 09:35 marks exist.
execution.sizing: At entry, long target 3% and short peer 3% of contemporaneous NAV. Scale all same-session pairs proportionally for the 1x hard gross cap.
execution.overlap: Skip an event if either target or peer is already active; same-session pairs are admitted in accession/ticker order without ticker reuse.
execution.capacity: Each leg notional must be <=1% of its own PIT lagged ADV20.

selection.rank: Among development-pass candidates, higher stress8 Sharpe, then higher base Sharpe, then more pair entries, then shorter hold.
selection.isolation: Select once on development. Validation cannot substitute the other hold.

audit_requirements: Persist mapped events, selected peers, daily/event/trade ledgers, ticker contribution, summary, yearly attribution, QA, selection, and manifest.

Report pair counts, target and peer concentration, top1/top3/top5/top10 positive-PnL shares, effective ticker count, dollar DD, percentage DD, turnover, borrow, financing, gross, missing marks, and broad-PIT beta/residual alpha.
Separate rule-selection effect from rebuilt trade-selection effect. No PnL subtraction or refill shortcut.
